scope: Offline strict-OOF P8u Router50 and single-Base comparison only. No live, canonical promotion, exchange, portfolio, or execution mutation.

root_cause.finding: The default reconciled rich-policy ledger begins on 2025-04-01, so a May Router fold with a three-month training window has no resolved January-March labels.
root_cause.repair: Reconstruct only 2024-12 through 2025-03 rich-policy labels from target-free path identities, local 15-minute OHLC, and the pre-existing frozen smooth-protection policy; append them before the unchanged canonical ledger in a new immutable successor.
root_cause.invalidity_contract: Missing entry/ATR metadata and incomplete paths remain policy_path_valid=false and are excluded from fitting; they are not economic failures.

router.contract: frozen P8u_floor100_cap250 primary-only rank-XENDCG Router50; 30 causal features; 3-month strict training, 28-day reserve, 120,000-query-safe row cap; no router numeric coordinate enters Base
router.feature_sources: disjoint target-free Dec-Mar, Apr-Jul-2025, and Aug-2025-Jul-2026 causal feature roots; every required Router/B0 F72 field present

base_target_comparison.common_contract: exact same Router50 identities, F72 causal features, LightGBM LambdaRank geometry, three-month strict training, 28-day reserve, 60,000 complete-query cap, and canonical rich-policy labels; held August 2025 through July 2026

models.raw_magnitude_challenger: policy net bps with training-fold winsorised six-quantile relevance bins

base_target_comparison.decision: RETAIN_POLICY_ORDINAL_CONTROL_FOR_THIS_ROUTER_FIRST_COMMON_LIGHTGBM_CONTRACT. Raw magnitude improves breadth but fails the predeclared Top-1/Top-2, utility-recall, and selection-score gates. This does not supersede the separately evaluated CatBoost F72 qualified challenger.

tests: Focused direct test functions passed; Python compilation passed; persisted April/May label coverage checks passed; git diff --check passed. pytest is unavailable in the active Python runtime, so no pytest result is claimed.
